body:
This semantic-only change fixes two observed output-tail translations:

- `FSETP.GEU` now emits `setp.geu.f32` in the floating comparison path. Other FSETP comparisons retain the existing selector.
- `F2FP.BF16.F32.PACK_AB` now emits `cvt.rn.bf16x2.f32`; the existing FP16 PACK_AB path remains `cvt.rn.f16x2.f32`.

Validation: an isolated four-module offline CPU 46 build and two direct fixtures passed. CUDA 13.1 `ptxas -arch=sm_120` assembled both generated PTX modules. No full workspace/LLVM build or GPU run was performed. The v7 combined candidate passed same-process byte comparison for 12,288 output bytes; that is a combined-candidate result, not an independent GPU validation of this PR. This change does not claim full ISA support.

Only `ptx/src/sass/lifter.rs` is changed; no FSEL, HI, CS2R/register-pair, HBF, or other QKV candidate changes are included.

commits.messageHeadline: Preserve GEU and BF16 PACK_AB semantics

title: Preserve FSETP.GEU and BF16 PACK_AB semantics
